notes.title: EASY MODE IS HERE!! (THIRD UPDATE)
notes.content:
Hello people, we are back with big changes!!
As we promised, we added an EASY MODE ːwinter2019happybulbː to improve your experience in the world of Magical Miri.

Now, before you start any stage, you'll be asked for a difficulty level to choose: Normal Mode or Easy Mode.

What's different in Easy Mode:
- You won't die if you fall, instead, you'll lose some health and reappear at some place near your fall. ːsteamhappyː
- Infinite lives, so you won't have to repeat all the stage once and again. ːretlawinː
- Spikes are less dangerous. ːwinter2019happyyulː
- Miri causes more damage by default. ːbroflexː
- More clothing items and potions can be found in the small chests. ːcupupː

We added another changes that appear in both Easy and Normal mode:
- The Recovery Move is now EASIER to perform. So, jam that shield button once you get hit if you don't want to be thrown far away! ːretlawinː
- We lower the cost of "ED perk" to 2 perk points. If you HATE THAT THROW BACK every time you get hit, be sure to spend your perk points in this skill. ːretlawinː
- Some minor changes to certain stages to ease your experience.

We care for your requests, because, we are gamers too.
Take care and have fun!
Estudio Roxis team.
Roberto De Lamia and Alexis Páez.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello, Estudio Roxis here!

We are still working on the game to give you a better experience, this time we added Tips on Game Over screen, so, if you need some advice, maybe you can find it there.

Take care!

notes.title: Second update
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

As we said on the first update, we are attending suggestions of the community to improve the game.
This time we added more keys on the keyboard to map, for example, now you can map the jump button on the spacebar or whatever you want.
Mushrooms on Groovy Woods now gives you a little more impulse.
And finally, we changed the first dialogue on Groovy Woods to be more clear, that the rain, damages your clothes bit by bit. (FYI you can disable the rain, but you have to finish one stage, any stage)

Stay safe!

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We fixed the controllers support. You must navigate thru the options with your keyboard, but just for the first time until you configure your gamepad.

Also, we changed a little the "Groovy woods" stage, so it is less annoying.

Since this is our first video game, we know it has some issues, but we are listening to all your suggestions and analysing your streams and videos to improve our work and give you a better product.

We are open to constructive criticism. Thank you all for your support!

Have fun! :)

Estudio Roxis team.
Roberto de Lamia and Alexis Páez

tags.balance_change: Also, we changed a little the "Groovy woods" stage, so it is less annoying.
